changelog: 🛡️ Permanent Database Deletion & Anti-Resurrection: Deleted notes, tasks, habits, and projects are now immediately and atomically purged from SQLite, guaranteeing they never resurrect on app relaunch
🔄 Cross-Platform SQLite Reconciliation: Universal multi-layer reconciliation synchronizes database rows across Linux AppImage, Electron Desktop, Android APK, and Web
⚡ Persistent Sync Pairing Across Sessions: Heartbeat timeouts and browser restarts no longer wipe pairing credentials; devices stay permanently linked and auto-reconnect silently
🧹 Total Database Wipe Support: 'Erase LifeLog on this device' in Settings now cleanly resets all SQLite tables and cleans disk vaults
💀 Tombstone Sync Architecture: Deletions generate deterministic cryptographic tombstones preventing peer syncing from reviving deleted items
